description: Basic zombie. Slow but steady, eats plants in its path.
Wears a traffic cone for extra protection. Destroy the cone first!
A bucket on his head provides massive protection. Very tough!
Medieval armor covers this zombie. Destroy helmet and shoulders first.
An ice block protects this zombie. Very durable protection!
Massive zombie that destroys plants in one hit. Throws an Imp at half health!
Tiny but fast zombie thrown by Gargantuar. Deals damage quickly.
Charges at full speed, instantly killing anything in its path while running.
Pushes an arcade machine. Releases two Imps when machine is destroyed.
Her parasol deflects all lobber projectiles. Immune to aerial attacks!
Steals your sun over 5 seconds then fires a laser destroying 4 plants!
Has dynamite that explodes after 10s, sending him backward across the map!
Plays piano music that randomly shifts zombies between lanes every few seconds.
Reads a newspaper. When it's destroyed, he gets enraged and moves much faster!
Pushes a barrel. When barrel breaks, two Imps emerge from it!
Raises sun from the ground magnetically, stealing it from you!
Carries a torch that burns nearby plants. Ice extinguishes the torch!
Spits bones to create tombstones on random tiles every few seconds.
Flies over obstacles on a dodo bird. Can't fly over Tall-Nuts.
Throws ice at plants, incrementing their freeze level. 3 hits = frozen!
Pushes ice blocks forward. Blocks kill plants and hypnotized zombies on contact!
Stays at the right edge and hooks plants, pulling them one tile to the right.
Swims underwater through water tiles, only vulnerable to lobbers when submerged.
Throws octopuses at plants, freezing them similar to Hunter's ice effect.
Spins when hit by projectiles, deflecting them back at your plants!
Turns plants into harmless cats! They revert when the wizard is killed.
Stays at right edge, upgrading nearby regular zombies to Knights!
Like Imp but immune to fire damage. Beware!
Zombotany Peashooter: fires peas left toward your plants!
Zombotany WallNut: extremely tough zombie that moves slowly.
Zombotany Jalapeno: burns entire row if alive for 10+ seconds!
Zombotany Squash: moves fast and destroys both itself and the plant it hits.
I, Zombie exclusive: produces sun for you over time. Protect it!
